quotes.author: Jason
quotes.text: Celebrated my brother's birthday on their yacht and it turned out to be the highlight of our trip. Great sound system, attentive crew, and the yacht was stunning. Couldn’t have asked for a better setup!

quotes.author: Samantha Green
quotes.text: I booked this service for a birthday party and hands down it was the best experience ever. Highly recommend for an unforgettable night. Driver was also able to make the ride more enjoyable by taking us to all the best spots for views and spots of interest. Company was fairly priced, gave quick prompt responses and provided us with all useful information prior to boarding on what to expect.

quotes.author: Mounes Montazerii
quotes.text: I had a nice experience. Everything was perfect, nice boat and clean. The price is affordable and reasonable. Thank you for your nice customer service.

quotes.author: Michael Torres
quotes.text: It was great experience, Me and My friends enjoyed a lot. Highly recommended.

quotes.author: Sav Dulai
quotes.text: I booked “Book Luxury Boat” for my friend’s birthday as a surprise for him and I am falling short of words to express how much they impressed me and my friends with their wonderful decor and super delicious food. Everything was on point. The service was excellent starting from booking them till serving all of us. The staff is so friendly. All my friends really liked it and appreciated. Hence, 5 stars to the great customer service. Looking forward to more such events and good experiences. Keep up the good work guys!! Kudos!!!

quotes.author: Ridhima Suri
quotes.text: Kay is the man you need to go to if planning a special event! He went above and beyond in making mine and my husband's 40th birthday a grand success. He was prompt to reply over messages and we coordinated all small details. He was patient and honest as I asked him a million questions. I trusted him and he did not let me down. He planned everything from exceptional food to drinks and was there on time at the venue. He even came back to an alternate docking point with ice which he had missed to give us initially. I highly recommend Book Luxury Boat and ask for Kushal to make your event the best!
